name: Bilt Palladium Card

reward_currency.name: Bilt Points
reward_currency.valuation_basis: TPG editorial transfer-partner valuation; not guaranteed cash value

base_reward.label: Effective 3.33X catch-all: 2X Bilt Points plus 4% Bilt Cash converted to housing points; applies while Flexible Bilt Cash is selected and housing unlock capacity remains (about the first 75% of monthly housing spend)
base_reward.cap_formula: eligible everyday spend <= 0.75 × monthly rent or mortgage payment
base_reward.condition: Flexible Bilt Cash rewards option is selected and the cardholder will redeem all earned Bilt Cash to unlock up to 1X Bilt Points on that billing cycle's housing payment

components.label: 4% Bilt Cash converted at $0.03 per housing point

reward_rules.label: up to 5X Bilt Dining depending on partner bonus structure

benefits.title: Bilt Cash annually
benefits.description: $200 nominal Bilt Cash annually; valued conservatively through the housing-points redemption at one-third dollar per $1 Bilt Cash

valuation.basis: $1 Bilt Cash unlocks 33.333 Bilt Points at Bilt's $30-to-1,000 housing-points rate; valued at the 1-cent-per-point cash floor, the $200 annual allocation is worth $66.67. This intentionally excludes Bilt's separate dollar-for-dollar partner redemptions.

benefits.title: annual Bilt Travel Hotel Credit
benefits.description: $400 annual Bilt Travel Hotel Credit split $200 Jan-Jun and $200 Jul-Dec, subject to portal and stay requirements

valuation.basis: Issuer-stated $200 maximum per semiannual hotel-credit period

benefits.title: Priority Pass access
benefits.description: Priority Pass access subject to current terms

valuation.basis: Lounge membership is tracked but excluded from automatic card ROI

spend_threshold_benefits: Point Accelerator can exchange eligible Bilt Cash for +1X on the next $5,000 of spend, up to stated annual limits

Under Flexible Bilt Cash, Palladium's 2X base plus 4% Bilt Cash redeemed at $30 per 1,000 housing points is an effective 3.33X catch-all until earned Bilt Cash covers the monthly housing-points unlock; this occurs after everyday spend reaches about 75% of the monthly housing payment
offer_ecosystem: Bilt neighborhood/dining and app promotions; merchant opportunities vary
other_key_benefits: Up to 1.25X on rent/mortgage/HOA with no transaction fee when qualifying housing-only rewards option is selected, subject to Bilt program terms
notes: Bilt Cash and hotel credits have distinct expiration/reset rules. The 3.33X catch-all model assumes Flexible Bilt Cash and housing-points redemption; it is capped by the holder's monthly housing payment and is not the Housing-only rewards option. Hotel credit requires eligible Bilt Travel bookings and minimum-stay terms; model each half-year as a separate benefit cycle

valuation.basis: Issuer-stated $200 of Bilt Cash per calendar year

raw_source_fields.bonus_categories: 4X hotels through Bilt Travel; 3X flights through Bilt Travel; 4X Lyft; up to 5X Bilt Dining depending on partner bonus structure
raw_source_fields.recurring_credits: $200 Bilt Cash annually; $400 annual Bilt Travel Hotel Credit split $200 Jan-Jun and $200 Jul-Dec, subject to portal and stay requirements
raw_source_fields.annual_or_anniversary_benefits: Priority Pass access subject to current terms
raw_source_fields.spend_threshold_benefits: Point Accelerator can exchange eligible Bilt Cash for +1X on the next $5,000 of spend, up to stated annual limits
